title: Headstash 2026: store the note circuit
summary: Stores the Headstash vk_id 3 Halo2 note circuit (K=11, verifying-key hash sha256(params||vk) 34d11437d957554f4008377dece5fac0f047e0e9cc012d15b3d09448a6cc5398) in the circuit module with x/gov as sender. This is the only x/gov step of the initial headstash dry run: the Foundation DAO deploys two cw-headstash instances, terpy at terp16ww6y3e7y63v98d9jzg0cft2u0ztx5kda0zvr0e90kwawh4hxweqhtvv7q and thioly at terp1yc4qtcwzv6g55vqrj95xq8anruwyy2ly4narcqs4a2hzgnu6rlrsa4s9r7, and binds this circuit to both in Foundation DAO proposal 2. Nothing is funded by this proposal.

## Headstash 2026 in short
The Headstash airdrop set: a private airdrop to holders from 15 EVM communities plus the Solana community stoned-ape-club:
17,791 eligible identities (15,744 EVM, 2,047 Solana) share 98,841 notes in 12 denominations (1 to 5,000 TERP),
totalling 66,456,669 tokens (6 decimals). 37 addresses were excluded (burn/zero addresses,
contracts, Safes and program-owned accounts).

Communities: EVM: buddah-bears, cannabuddies, carta-beta-gang, chronic-token, crypto-canna-club, cryptowizards, galacktic-gang, heady-pipe-society, hippie-life-krew, monster-buds, rebud, secret-sesh, shurlok, special-k, wake-and-bake. Solana: stoned-ape-club.

How a claim works:
1. Register: the holder signs a native registration message with the wallet that held the NFT
   (EIP-191 ECDSA for EVM, ed25519 for Solana). The message binds a note-key commitment to the eligible amount.
2. Claim: the holder proves ownership of a note with the Halo2 note circuit (vk_id 3, K=11) verified on-chain by
   the Terp circuit module, so the claiming Terp address is not linked to the source wallet on-chain.

Initial dry run (this round):
- The identical airdrop set is paid in two fresh tokenfactory tokens, terpy and thioly, not TERP. Each has a total supply of exactly
  the allocation, 66,456,669,000,000 base units (98,841 notes), with one cw-headstash instance per token.
- Foundation DAO terp14w2qva6dx6wcsmq5fvplh7cr7nvptejznyvpe5hp5mtyqhxxjamsz3kw2w proposal 1 creates factory/<DAO>/terpy and factory/<DAO>/thioly, sets their metadata, mints the allocation,
  instantiates the two contracts (wasm admin, owner and pauser: the Foundation DAO), opens the campaign and funds each, then hands the
  tokenfactory admin of both denoms to terp1qqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqqq5ffndw (the all-zero address, no key). Supply and metadata can never change again.
- Foundation DAO proposal 2 binds this circuit to both instances, which opens claims.
- Claim cutoff at block 44,444,444. Before it, the DAO can EmergencyReclaim (balance to the community pool, claims halt for good);
  after it, unclaimed tokens can only be burned (SweepUnclaimed). The DAO can Pause/Resume. WAVS is disabled.

## What this proposal does
Stores the note circuit (vk_id 3, K=11) with x/gov as the sender. Nothing is funded and no contract is instantiated by this proposal.
